scripts.build: pnpm run build:bundled && pnpm run build:slim
scripts.bundle:label: tsx scripts/label-bundles.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run format-check && pnpm run runtime:lint && pnpm run runtime:typecheck && pnpm run runtime:test && pnpm run frontend:lint && pnpm run frontend:test && pnpm run frontend:build && pnpm run rust:test
scripts.format: prettier --write .github .oxlintrc.json .prettierrc.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml runtime scripts apps/desktop/package.json apps/frontend packages/ui && pnpm run rust:format
scripts.format-check: prettier --check .github .oxlintrc.json .prettierrc.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml runtime scripts apps/desktop/package.json apps/frontend packages/ui && pnpm run rust:format-check
scripts.frontend:format: pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/frontend run format && pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/ui run format
scripts.frontend:format-check: pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/frontend run format-check && pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/ui run format-check
scripts.frontend:lint: pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/frontend run lint && pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/ui run lint
scripts.frontend:typecheck: pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/ui run typecheck && pnpm --filter @dsh-desktop/frontend run typecheck
